$comment: Single source of truth for the one-time child pairing code. Read by the backend (backend/src/pairing-code.js), by OpenAPI conformance tests, and by the Flutter app through the generated pairing_contract.generated.dart (tools/contracts/generate-dart.mjs). Change it here, regenerate, and the contract tests show every consumer that still disagrees. claimAttempts: at most maxFailures failed claims per source within windowMinutes; successful claims are not counted. Scope is the source (IP) because a claim carries only the code, so a wrong guess cannot be tied to one pairing.
